title: Plaxico Burress: Playing for the Jets and going to prison were "kind of similar"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Plaxico Burress: Playing for the Jets and going to prison were "kind of similar"
sources.description: Plaxico Burress's NFL career was put on hold during the 2008 season, when he accidentally shot himself and then went to prison for 20 months for carrying a gun illegally.
